title: Bee Removal in New Rochelle, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in New Rochelle, Westchester. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, eaves, and ground. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert stinging insect removal throughout New Rochelle, Westchester County. Our licensed technicians locate and treat active wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests in wall voids, attics, soffits, eaves, and structural wood — then seal every entry point to prevent recolonization. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
whyUs: With years of experience serving New Rochelle and surrounding Westchester communities, Best Pest Control NYC combines local expertise with proven bee removal techniques. Our team responds quickly to bee emergencies, uses eco-friendly methods, and provides thorough inspections to prevent future infestations in your New Rochelle property.
localContext: New Rochelle's diverse architecture — from historic homes near Paine Avenue to modern condos along the waterfront and the established neighborhoods around Hudson Park — offers countless nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets. Pre-war buildings with aging soffits, suburban homes with wood trim, and commercial properties along North Avenue and Main Street all develop gaps where paper-nest colonies establish themselves inside wall cavities, attics, and roof lines. Our technicians are familiar with the structural pest control challenges these nesting insects create in New Rochelle's mix of construction types.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in New Rochelle?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in New Rochelle?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service for most wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket removal requests in New Rochelle and throughout Westchester County. For emergency situations involving aggressive colonies or allergic residents, we prioritize immediate response to ensure your safety.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in New Rochelle?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of properties do you service in New Rochelle?
faqs.answer: We provide wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal for all property types in New Rochelle, including single-family homes, multi-unit buildings, condominiums, commercial properties, schools, and municipal buildings. Our technicians have experience locating and treating nests in both historic and modern structures throughout the area.
